mechanism_narrative: A quarterly expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) indicates strengthening economic activity, which increases corporate earnings growth expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next quarter (60 trading days).
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth rate is positive in the prior quarter but S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.10% over the past month signals aggressive monetary easing, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS falls below 0.10% but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of such triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, which increases consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Both PAYEMS and UNRATE move in the expected direction (PAYEMS up, UNRATE down) but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 10.0%), the S&P 500 tends to rebound as the Federal Reserve initiates stimulus measures, producing positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 10.0% but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate above 2.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of such triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly expansion in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth is positive in the prior month but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: In low housing starts regimes (HOUST < 1000 thousand units), the S&P 500 tends to decline as housing weakness signals broader economic slowdown, producing negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1000 but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and increase in retail sales (RSAFS) signals effective monetary policy stimulating consumer spending, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS declines and RSAFS increases but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of such cases.
